pkgmetadata.longdescription: BedrockOnLinux is a launcher for the Windows (GDK) edition of Minecraft Bedrock. It downloads a WineGDK-based engine and the game from the Microsoft Store, signs in to Microsoft/Xbox natively and enables Friends, Servers, Realms and file imports. No game files are included.

use.flag: Use sys-devel/crossdev for the toolchain rather than dev-util/mingw64-toolchain (requires manual setting up and is mostly unsupported, try disabling if have issues)
Install the Qt launcher window (dev-python/pyside) and its desktop entry; without it only the command line is available
Use the system net-libs/webkit-gtk for the Microsoft sign-in window instead of the WebKitGTK bundle the launcher downloads
